fields.description:
## Context / Problem
Reframed 2026-08-19 (operator session; original framing was one escaped contradiction):
**the code-review gate cannot block consequential test-sufficiency findings, because the
code-v3 impact model discards the verifier's own user-reach judgments.**

Exemplar (the fire case): commit `8eadb4fbc5` shipped a contract declaring "`stale>0` alone
is allowed (exit 0)" and a test asserting `stale=0` — jointly contradictory (bug
`dystopian-bardlike-basil`).

Why review missed it (code-v3 corpus: 1881 sidecars / 1243 changes / 3384 findings; replay
reproduces stored v3 priorities exactly; evidence in comments):
- **Pass-1 recall gap**: the `tests` litmus is refactor-based; an assertion breaking on a
  legitimate future *improvement* matches no antipattern.
- **Pass-3 scoring gap**: maint lane × churn90 — absent on 80%, absent ⇒ ×0.5, capping the
  dominant binary at ~0.30. Pass-2's answered `prod_impact`/`trigger_likelihood` are
  DISCARDED for that lane, yet separate the corpus: 1120/1664 tests findings are prod=none/low
  internal-edge gaps (correctly advisory); the prod=medium/high tail (70) is load-bearing.
- **Posture gap**: `tests` is advisory@0.95, blocking disabled.

## Approach
Three coupled changes (one deliverable: tests-dimension recall AND calibrated teeth):

1. **Pass-1 recall** — add a "contract-contradicting assertion" antipattern to
   `code-review-tests.md`: flag a test forbidding a state the same diff's contract (docstring
   / exit-code semantics / commit message) declares allowed; quote BOTH halves verbatim.
   Guards: stated deliberate tightening not flagged; pure-function exact-value asserts stay
   valid (existing guard iv).
2. **Pass-2 vocabulary** — (a) new serious maintainability binary
   `forbids_contract_allowed_state` in `CodeSeverityAttrs` + the verify prompt
   (both-halves-verbatim evidence; stated intent to tighten ⇒ FALSE). (b) Re-scope the
   `prod_impact` / `trigger_likelihood` descriptions in BOTH `code-review-verify.md` and
   `verify_models.py` (today production-scoped only) to also key the maint lane's user-reach
   damping: for a coverage/contract finding, `prod_impact` = user-facing reach of the guarded
   path; `trigger_likelihood` = how often a legitimate user action exercises it (rare ⇒
   ×0.75; sometimes/common ⇒ ×1.0). v3's impact_code never read prod_impact — consuming it is
   THE v4 scoring change; the doc amendment matches how verifiers already populate it (per
   crosstab), so the replay on historical values stays valid.
3. **Pass-3 impact model code-v4** (`impact_code` in decide.py; ADR 0036 version bump) —
   split the maint lane by binary class:
   - serious consequence (`unversioned_published_contract_break`,
     `safety_net_removal_without_replacement`, `forbids_contract_allowed_state`): ×1.0 undamped;
   - moderate consequence (`contract_drift`, `hidden_invariant`,
     `reachable_path_without_automated_coverage`): × prod_impact mult (high/med=1.0, low=0.6,
     none=0.5) × 0.75 when trigger_likelihood=rare — the user-reach keying;
   - debt (`implicit_coupling`, `dead_code`): churn becomes AMPLIFIER-ONLY
     (1.0 + 0.5·min(churn90,30)/30 ∈ [1.0,1.5]; operator decision: churn may only increase
     impact, never diminish). Churn stays out of the consequence lanes.
   - **reversibility floor restricted to the consequence lanes**: the current lane-blind
     floor would lift a minor debt binary on a hard_to_reverse surface to 0.6, crossing
     tests@0.54. In v4 the 0.6 floor requires consequence base>0 AND hard_to_reverse_surface;
     the debt lane never floors. Replay identical; the 4 existing debt-only+hard-to-reverse
     findings stay advisory.
   Prod-lane tiers/trigger mults, detection amp, priority=validity×impact unchanged. Moderate
   maint blocks via amp 1.0 (88% of tests findings carry escapes_automation/silent_failure —
   a coverage gap escapes automation by definition): 0.6×1.0=0.60 ≥ 0.54; non-silent moderate
   tops at 0.48 by design (gap already detected elsewhere).
4. **Routing** — flip `tests` to blocking@0.54 in packaged `criteria_routing.json`
   (operator-approved). Update every hard-equality consumer:
   `tests/unit/test_impact_model_versioning.py` (two `== "code-v3"` sites + 7-member
   blocking-set pin) and `tests/unit/test_code_review_ws2.py` (second pin) → 8-member set;
   `tests/unit/test_impact_code.py` → existing code-v3 literals are REVISED, not just
   augmented: moderate-lane churn-scaling cases removed (churn leaves that lane), cold-debt
   literals 0.12→0.24 (amplifier-only churn), moderate reachable_path expectations →
   prod_impact-keyed formula.

Corpus grounding (tables in comments): v3 blocks 42/1243 changes (3.4%); v4 + tests@0.54
blocks 99 (8.0%, operator-accepted). Zero demotions; no docs/cosmetic entries; prod=none/low
mass stays advisory; no new validity floor (existing val<0.5 drop stands). **Stored sidecars
are never rewritten**: version-gated scoring — new reviews emit code-v4; existing code-v3
sidecars are not re-scored or mutated (replay = offline analysis, not a migration). Recorded
verdicts (mechanism, ci-gate-compat distinction, gate survey): comments.

## Scope
`review_kernel/decide.py` (impact_code v4 + floor restriction), `verify_models.py` +
`code-review-verify.md` (new binary + re-scoped descriptions), `code-review-tests.md`
(antipattern), `code_review/criteria_routing.json` + `sidecar.py` (flip + version bump),
`tests/unit/test_impact_model_versioning.py` + `test_code_review_ws2.py` (pins),
`test_impact_code.py` (v4 arithmetic), `eval_specs/code-review-tests.eval.yaml` +
`code-review-verify.eval.yaml`, `docs/experiments/` (replay). Full paths in file_impact.

## Testing
- Unit: v4 arithmetic — serious-maint undamped; prod_impact keying incl. none/low damping;
  amplifier-only churn (churn=0 ⇒ multiplier exactly 1.0, never 0.5); floor fires for a
  consequence-lane binary on a hard_to_reverse surface but a debt-only finding there stays at
  its debt score (max 0.45 — advisory under tests@0.54); absent-binary abstention unchanged.
- Integration: the fire case's verified severity attributes fed through impact_code +
  the packaged tests@0.54 threshold yield a BLOCK end-to-end.
- Evals: fire case (the `8eadb4fbc5` tolerance/assert pair) + pass cases (stated deliberate
  tightening; pure-function exact-value assert) in `code-review-tests.eval.yaml`; a case in
  `code-review-verify.eval.yaml` asserting `forbids_contract_allowed_state` is emitted for
  the fire case and NOT for the tightening pass case.
- Replay: the committed replay script re-run against the landed formula reproduces the
  recorded v4 would-block set (163 findings / 99 changes).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `impact_code` ships the code-v4 lane split above (incl. consequence-lane-only
      reversibility floor); `IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION == "code-v4"`; stored code-v3 sidecar files
      are not rewritten or re-scored in place; a sidecar lacking the new binary gets 0
      contribution from it.
- [ ] `forbids_contract_allowed_state` exists in `CodeSeverityAttrs` and the Pass-2 prompt
      with both-halves-verbatim evidence and the deliberate-tightening guard; the
      `prod_impact`/`trigger_likelihood` descriptions in both files state the maintainability
      user-reach keying.
- [ ] `code-review-tests.md` carries the contract-contradicting-assertion antipattern + guards.
- [ ] Packaged routing: `tests` blocking@0.54 with a `_comment` citing this ticket + replay;
      BOTH pin files (`test_impact_model_versioning.py`, `test_code_review_ws2.py`) assert the
      8-member set and `IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION == "code-v4"` at both equality sites.
- [ ] The fire/pass cases pass in `code-review-tests.eval.yaml`; the verify-eval case in
      `code-review-verify.eval.yaml` covers the new binary's emission and its tightening guard.
- [ ] Replay script + results committed under `docs/experiments/`; re-run reproduces 163/99,
      and a debt-only+hard_to_reverse finding scores advisory.
